gaps.name: pipe: its path build cannot match a pipe drawn foreshortened
gaps.reason: A path build that follows its concept correctly: the concept draws the pipe as one slanted line hidden in three places, about 18 to 1, while its row is 10 x 0.1 m (100 to 1), likely a pipe receding along the wall, so the outline against a face-on cut cannot match (0.228 built, 0.211 baked). A straight sweep scores 0.797 only by making it 0.4 m thick, and treating runs hidden in pieces as straight broke three other builds (#36). The owner kept the row. Asked: "Garage's pipe: accept as a gap or change its planned size?" Answer: "Accept as a gap".
gaps.decided: owner (@JoeyKardolus), 2026-10-29, in chat through the score session
faults: pipe: outline 0.246 under 0.5 (prop route), after 37aa882c dropped this record expecting a pass; restored as decided, 2026-10-29
